messages:
sara: Quick triage — we have multiple customer asks for an Optimize tooling playbook: per-route batching & caching recommendations, quantization suggestions, and eval-triggered alerts.
sara: Need launch criteria + prioritization. Who can give rough tech estimates and show must-have vs nice-to-have?
devin: I can take batching/caching. Biggest unknown is getting stable runtime metrics (latency distribution, prefix reuse) out of serving.
devin: Ballpark: 2 sprints to build recommendation engine prototype (offline), + 1 sprint for API + UI to show recs.
lexi: From customers: acceptable MVP = non-invasive recs + cost/latency delta estimates. Must-haves for launch:
lexi: - per-route recs (batch size, cache TTL)
lexi: - visible cost delta estimate per rec
lexi: - basic guardrails (don't apply to private by default)
mike: Quantization recommendations are model-sensitive. For open LLMs we can provide conservative Q8/Q4 suggestions and a safety label (risk: hallucination/regression).
mike: Est: 3 sprints to build profiling pipeline + baseline evals for top 5 models.
anjali: Eval-triggered alerts: tie into existing eval infra (evals service). Need to define schema for alerts and sample-size rules. Privacy note: for Private deployments we must avoid shipping raw prompts.
devin: Engineering breakdown (rough):
devin: - Recs engine offline prototype: 2 sprints
devin: - Backend service + DB + telemetry hooks: 3 sprints (depends on runtime-team)
devin: - UI + rollout controls: 1 sprint
runtime-team: We can add lightweight telemetry hooks (prefix reuse, per-request tokens, latency hist) — need a small contract. ETA: 2 sprints.
sara: Proposed launch waves to manage scope:
sara: Wave 1 (MVP): offline recs + UI showing cost/latency delta, per-route only, eval safety warnings (no auto-apply).
sara: Wave 2: quant profiles + integration for suggested quant configs, apply flow behind feature flag.
sara: Wave 3: eval-triggered alerts + one-click safe rollout + canary automation.
lexi: Customers asked for runbooks for Dedicated/Private (how to opt out, how telemetry behaves). Add to launch criteria for Wave1 (docs).
ops-bot: Reminder: security review required for Private deployment telemetry — ticket SEC-2026-123 created.
mike: For eval alerts, propose simple config example to start with:
mike: ```
mike: alert: regression
mike: metric: rouge_l
mike: threshold: 0.02
mike: window: 1000
mike: notify: #oncall-product
mike: ```
devin: That looks fine — we should also emit a per-recommendation CI that shows expected tokens saved vs risk.
sara: Quick prioritization ask: rank features by customer impact + dev cost. My suggestion:
sara: 1) per-route recs + cost delta (high impact, low-med dev)
sara: 2) eval alerts (high impact, med dev)
sara: 3) quantization suggestions (high impact for cost, higher dev)
lexi: Agree. Also capture two pilot customers for Wave1 — @lexi will collect names and sample routes.
devin: Next steps: devin + mike to produce a 10-min tech demo + prototype plan by Mon (ts: 1876600000).
sara: @runtime-team can you draft the telemetry contract this week? Need to unblock dev infra.
runtime-team: Will do — sharing doc in #eng-runtime by EOD Thu.
sara: Thanks all. Flagging open questions:
sara: - privacy contract for Private deployments (anjali)
sara: - sample customer routes for pilot (lexi)
sara: - telemetry contract (runtime-team)
sara: Reconcile at next sync and confirm Wave1 launch criteria. :thumbsup:
